newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-EVERTON DROP BID FOR NORWEGIAN PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EVERTON DROP BID FOR NORWEGIAN PLAYERS.

text.p: Everton withdrew their 3 million pound ($4.9 million) bid for two Norwegian players on Thursday as the club was left reeling by the departure of manager Joe Royle.
Norwegian side Brann Bergen on Wednesday rejected an offer of 2.5 million pounds for midfielder Claus Eftevaag and striker Tore Andre Flo.
Everton came back with an increased offer but then withdrew it three hours before Thursday's 1700GMT English league transfer deadline.
Shortly afterwards Royle announced he was to leave the club "by mutual consent."
"We got word a few hours ago," Brann chairman Lars Henrik Berge said.
The two players had come to Royle's attention during their team's European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final against Everton's neighbours and great rivals Liverpool.
